e.title: **一个**国际培训机构的**养老金改革教学模拟器**，**而它**此刻**无法调度****：Hugging Face Space `itcilo-actuarial/cnr-algeria-exercise`——**⭐ 逐字自述（法语）**「**Application pédagogique pour la formation actuarielle ITC-ILO 2026. Simulation du régime CNR (Algérie) — statu quo, à des fins pédagogiques uniquement.**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而**本次实测**运行接口**返回逐字**「**stage**」**为 `RUNTIME_ERROR`**、**「**errorMessage**」**为 `Scheduling failure: unable to schedule`****（**⭐ 并**同时**把域名状态写成 **`READY`**）**；**⭐ 界面有**三个阶段的问题**（**数据／**假设／**结果）与**四个改革杠杆的**瀑布图**（**「**Gap initial (4,22 pp)**」**）**；**⭐ 而**学员答案**会被写进一个**同名的数据集仓库**（**本次实测**该仓库返回 **401**）****
e.title_en: A pension reform teaching simulator published by an international training body that currently cannot be scheduled at all: its runtime reports a scheduling failure while the same response marks the domain as ready, its interface walks learners through data, assumptions and results with a waterfall of four reform levers starting from an initial gap, and the answers learners submit are written to a companion dataset repository that is not publicly readable.

Simulation du régime CNR (Algérie) — statu quo, à des fins pédagogiques uniquement.**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而**本次實測**運行介面**返回逐字**「**stage**」**為 `RUNTIME_ERROR`**、**「**errorMessage**」**為 `Scheduling failure: unable to schedule`****（**⭐ 並**同時**把域名狀態寫成 `READY`**）**；**⭐ 介面有**三個階段的問題**（**數據／**假設／**結果）與**四個改革槓桿的瀑布圖**；**⭐ 而**學員答案**會被寫進一個**同名的數據集倉庫**（**本次實測該倉庫返回 401**）****
e.summary: **CNR Algeria Actuarial Exercise**（Hugging Face Space `itcilo-actuarial/cnr-algeria-exercise`）**是一个**面向精算培训的**教学模拟应用****——**逐字自述（法语）为**「**Application pédagogique pour la formation actuarielle ITC-ILO 2026. Simulation du régime CNR (Algérie) — statu quo, à des fins pédagogiques uniquement.**」**（**⭐ 即**国际劳工组织国际培训中心 **2026 年**精算培训的**教学应用**，**模拟**阿尔及利亚 **CNR 制度**，**且**明确声明**只作**教学用途**）**。**本次实测**：**类型 **Docker****、**创建 **2026-06-09**、**最后修改 **2026-06-10**、**⭐ 主体应用是**一个 **2,180 行**（**118,447 字节**）的 **Dash 应用****、**依赖**逐字钉死**（**`dash==4.1.0`、**`dash-bootstrap-components==2.0.4`、**`plotly>=5.18.0`、**`pandas>=2.0.0`、**`huggingface_hub>=0.23.0`、**`gunicorn==23.0.0`**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**能跑的应用：一个 Space 的四种活法**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **它此刻**跑不起来**，**而**平台的两处状态**互相矛盾**（**运行接口**说 `RUNTIME_ERROR`／**而**同一份返回里**域名状态是 `READY`**）**；**② **教学流程按**三个阶段**组织**（**数据 → **假设 → **结果**）**，**每一阶段**都**把「**你凭什么这样假设**」**写成问题**；**③ **⭐ 四个改革杠杆**被画成**一张瀑布图**（**⭐ 从**「**Gap initial (4,22 pp)**」**逐项分解**）**；**④ **⭐ 学员的答案**会被**写进**一个**数据集仓库**（**本次实测**该仓库**返回 **401****）**。**⚠️ 本次**未启动该 Space、**未作答**。
e.summary_hk: **CNR Algeria Actuarial Exercise**（Hugging Face Space `itcilo-actuarial/cnr-algeria-exercise`）**是一個**面向精算培訓的**教學模擬應用****——**逐字自述（法語）為**「**Application pédagogique pour la formation actuarielle ITC-ILO 2026. Simulation du régime CNR (Algérie) — statu quo, à des fins pédagogiques uniquement.**」**（**⭐ 即**國際勞工組織國際培訓中心 2026 年精算培訓的**教學應用**，**模擬**阿爾及利亞 CNR 制度**，**並**明確聲明**只作教學用途**）**。**本次實測**：**類型 Docker**、**創建 2026-06-09**、**最後修改 2026-06-10**、**⭐ 主體應用是一個 2,180 行（**118,447 位元組**）的 Dash 應用****、**依賴逐字釘死**（**`dash==4.1.0`、**`dash-bootstrap-components==2.0.4`、**`plotly>=5.18.0`、**`pandas>=2.0.0`、**`huggingface_hub>=0.23.0`、**`gunicorn==23.0.0`**）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**能跑的应用：一個 Space 的四種活法**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **它此刻跑不起來**，**而**平台兩處狀態互相矛盾**（**運行介面說 `RUNTIME_ERROR`／**而同份返回裡**域名狀態是 `READY`**）**；**② **教學流程按三階段組織**（**數據 → **假設 → **結果**）**，**每階段都**把「**你憑什麼這樣假設**」**寫成問題**；**③ **⭐ 四個改革槓桿**被畫成一張**瀑布圖**（**從「**Gap initial (4,22 pp)**」**逐項分解**）**；**④ **⭐ 學員答案**會被寫進**一個數據集倉庫**（**本次實測該倉庫返回 401****）**。**⚠️ 本次**未啟動該 Space、**未作答**。
e.summary_en: This Hugging Face Space **is a teaching simulation application for actuarial training**, described verbatim in French as a pedagogical application for the 2026 actuarial training of an international labour training centre, simulating a national pension scheme on a status-quo basis and explicitly for teaching purposes only. **Measured this round**: a Docker Space created in June and last modified a day later, whose main application is a two-thousand-line dashboard script nearly a hundred and twenty kilobytes long, with dependencies pinned exactly. **This entry belongs to the round theme of applications that run, and of the several states a Space can be in.** **Four things are worth reading: it cannot run at present, and the platform states this in two contradictory places, since the runtime interface reports a runtime error while the same response marks the domain as ready; the teaching flow is organised in three stages from data to assumptions to results, and every stage turns why you assumed this into a question for the learner; four reform levers are drawn as a waterfall decomposition starting from an initial gap in percentage points; and answers submitted by learners are written into a companion dataset repository that returns an unauthorised response and is therefore not publicly readable.** **The Space was not started and no answers were submitted this round.**
e.body:
**CNR Algeria Actuarial Exercise**（Hugging Face Space `itcilo-actuarial/cnr-algeria-exercise`）**是一个**面向精算培训的**教学模拟应用****——**逐字自述（法语）为**「**Application pédagogique pour la formation actuarielle ITC-ILO 2026. Simulation du régime CNR (Algérie) — statu quo, à des fins pédagogiques uniquement.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**能跑的应用：一个 Space 的四种活法**」**。

**引号约定（本条）**：**所引法语原文含 ASCII 撇号**（**如**「**l**」**——**逐字續**「**’emploi**」、「**d**」**——**逐字續**「**’annuité**」、「**d**」**——**逐字續**「**’actualisation**」、「**d**」**——**逐字續**「**’urgence**」**）**，**本站按既有约定一律写作弯撇号 **U+2019****；**原文中的**重音符号与**连接号**亦按原样保留**。

**可核实信息（均 Hugging Face API、仓库文件与一次真实请求实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它此刻**跑不起来**，**而**平台的两处状态**互相矛盾****——**⭐ 本次请求**其域名**返回 **HTTP 503**、**49 字节**，**页面文字逐字为**「**Your space is in error, check its status on hf.co**」**；**⭐ 而**运行接口**返回逐字含**「**"stage":"RUNTIME_ERROR"**」**、**「**"errorMessage":"Scheduling failure: unable to schedule"**」**、**「**"hardware":{"current":null,"requested":"cpu-basic"}**」**、**「**"replicas":{"requested":1}**」**（**⭐ 即**只有**请求的副本数**，**没有**当前副本数**）**、**以及**「**"domains":[{"domain":"itcilo-actuarial-cnr-algeria-exercise.hf.space","stage":"READY"}]**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组字段**是本条最值得记的一处**：**⭐ 即**同一个返回里**「**运行阶段**」是**错误**，**而**「**域名阶段**」是 **`READY`****——**⭐ 故**若只看**后者**，**会以为**这个应用**可用**；**⭐ 而** `hardware.current` **为 **`null`** 与 **`replicas` **没有当前值**这两处**同时**说明**它**当下**没有被调度到任何算力**。**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**本次**无法确定**调度失败的原因**（**⭐ 本词条**不推测**是配额、**资源池还是**配置问题**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 教学流程按三个阶段组织，**而**每一阶段都在问「**你凭什么**」****——**⭐ 本次实测**其问题集共三组**（**⭐ 逐字标题为**）：**① **数据（**`D1`–**`D4`**）**：**「**Données démographiques nécessaires**」**、**「**Données financières de base**」**、**「**Données par type de bénéficiaire**」**、**「**Données manquantes — limites du modèle**」**；**② **假设（**`H1`–**`H5`**）**：**「**Hypothèse de croissance de l**」**——**逐字續**「**’emploi**」**、**「**Taux d**」**——**逐字續**「**’actualisation — sensibilité du GAP**」**、**「**Hypothèse de mortalité — amélioration future**」**、**「**Paramètres du régime — sensibilité**」**、**「**Hypothèse de couverture et économie informelle**」**；**③ **结果（**`R1`–**`R4`**）**：**「**Lecture du taux PAYG**」**、**「**Le GAP actuariel — signification et utilité**」**、**「**Déficit nominal vs déficit structurel**」**等**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组标题**本身就是一份**可抄的教学大纲**：**⭐ 即**数据阶段**专门留了一问**「**缺失的数据与模型的局限**」**，**假设阶段**把**贴现率**与**死亡率改善**分开问**，**结果阶段**要求**区分**名义赤字与**结构性赤字**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 四个改革杠杆被画成一张**瀑布图****——**⭐ 本次实测**其代码里的瀑布标签逐字为**「**Gap initial (4,22 pp)**」**、**「**Âge légal**」**、**「**Cotisation**」**、**「**Taux d**」**——**逐字續**「**’annuité**」**、**「**Couverture formelle**」**、**「**Résiduel**」**——**⭐ 即**把**起点缺口 **4.22 个百分点****，**按**法定退休年龄、**缴费率、**年金率与**正规部门覆盖率**四项**逐项分解**，**最后留一项**残差**；**⭐ 而**界面里的**制度参数**逐字为**「**âge légal 60 ans, taux d**」**——**逐字續**「**’annuité 2,5 %, durée plein 32 ans, taux de cotisation 18,25 %**」**，**并**要求学员**把这四项**按**敏感度排序**；**⭐ 另有**KPI 卡逐字含**「**GAP actuariel (50 ans)**」（**值 **22,47 %**）**、**「**Taux de cotisation : 18,25 %**」与**「**Espérance de vie à 60 ans — engagement financier long terme**」**；**⭐ 还给出**一个**覆盖率情景**逐字为**「**Si la couverture passe de 55 % à 70 % d**」**——**逐字續**「**’ici 2035**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组**是本条**对 RIAA 最有用的部分**：**⭐ 即**它把**「**一份养老金改革建议**」**拆成**四个**可单独调、**可单独归因的**杠杆**，**并**要求**学员**为**每一项**给出**精算理由**。**⭐⭐ ④ 交付物是**一份有四项要求的**备忘****——**本次实测**其最终任务逐字要求**「**une note synthétisant**」**：**「**(1) le diagnostic chiffré**」**、**「**(2) le niveau d**」**——**逐字續**「**’urgence de la réforme**」**、**「**(3) votre recommandation prioritaire avec justification actuarielle**」**、**「**(4) et le principal risque politique ou social à gérer**」**——**⭐ 即**数字诊断、**改革紧迫度、**有精算依据的**优先建议、**以及**主要政治或社会风险**。**⭐ 本词条认为**第 ④ 项**最值得记**：**⭐ 即**它**要求学员**在**技术结论之外**写出**一个**非技术风险**（**政治或社会**）**——**⭐ 这与本会话多次记下的**「**把假设与结论摆在一起**」**同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 学员的答案会被写进一个数据集仓库，**而**本次实测**它**读不到****——**⭐ 应用里**有一个常量逐字为** `DATASET_REPO = "itcilo-actuarial/cnr-responses"`**，**并有**一个保存函数**把**参与者与答案**写成 **`responses.csv` ****（**⭐ 依赖里有 **`huggingface_hub`**，**且**用 **`HF_TOKEN` 环境变量**）**；**⭐ 本次实测**该数据集仓库**返回 **HTTP 401****——**⭐ 即**它**不是**公开可读的**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实指出**：**这套教学应用**不仅**收答案**，**而且**答案**落在一个**外部仓库**里**——**⭐ 故**它是**一个**会**把学员输入带出运行环境**的教学应用**（**⭐ 本词条**不主张**其**数据处理**是否适当**，**只记录这一结构**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[openfisca-tunisia-pension]]、**[[colombian-pension-observatory]]、**[[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]]、**[[rentenlueckenrechner]]、**[[pension-pro-mcp]] 覆盖**养老金测算与**制度改革工具**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**由**国际培训机构**发布的**教学用养老金改革模拟器**，**且**当前**无法调度****」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **把教学流程分成**数据／**假设／**结果三段**，**并**在**数据阶段就要求写清局限**；**② **改革建议要能拆成**若干可归因的**杠杆**，**并**画成**瀑布图**；**③ **结论之外**要写**一个**非技术风险**；**④ **读平台状态时**要看**运行阶段**，**不要**只看**域名阶段**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有启动该应用、**没有作答**（**未提交任何参数、**未生成任何测算**）**，**故**不主张**其任何模型结果**、**也不主张**其中**任何数字的**正确性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库文件与**平台接口**；**⭐ 结构按**文件名、**字节数与**代码中的标题字符串记录**，**未逐行通读** 2,180 行应用代码**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**数据来源**（**⭐ 只知**界面**自述**为**模拟**且**只作教学用途**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**制度参数与**实际制度**的关系**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录**界面中逐字出现的**参数值**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**同名数据集仓库**的**可见性设置**（**⭐ 只知**本次**返回 **401****）**，**也**未核实**其**是否符合**任何**数据保护要求**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**该 Space 与**培训机构**的**授权关系**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录**其**账号名**与**自述**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该 Space **创建于 **2026-06-09**、**最后修改 **2026-06-10**（**均在**解冻窗口之外**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**由**国际培训机构发布的**教学用养老金改革模拟器**，**其**运行阶段与**域名阶段**在平台返回里**互相矛盾**」这一形态**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该应用**自述为**教学用途**，**其任何输出**不构成**精算意见**，**也不得**用于**真实制度的**改革决策**。

%**」**，**並**要求學員把這四項**按敏感度排序**；**⭐ KPI 卡逐字含**「**GAP actuariel (50 ans)**」（**22,47 %**）**、**「**Taux de cotisation : 18,25 %**」與**「**Espérance de vie à 60 ans — engagement financier long terme**」**；**⭐ 本次實測**該數據集倉庫**返回 HTTP 401**——**⭐ 即**它不是**公開可讀的**；**⭐ 故**這套教學應用**不僅收答案**，**而且**答案落在一个**外部倉庫**裡**（**⭐ 不主張**其數據處理**是否適當**，**只記錄這一結構**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 本條補上的是**「**由國際培訓機構發布的教學用養老金改革模擬器，**且當前**無法調度****」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **把教學流程分成**數據／**假設／**結果三段**，**並**在數據階段就要求寫清局限**；**② **改革建議要能拆成**可歸因的槓桿**，**並**畫成瀑布圖**；**③ **結論之外**寫**一個非技術風險**；**④ **讀平台狀態時**要看**運行階段**，**不要只看**域名階段**。

e.body_en:
This Hugging Face Space **is a teaching simulation application for actuarial training**, described verbatim in French as a pedagogical application for the 2026 actuarial training of an international labour training centre, simulating a national pension scheme on a status-quo basis and explicitly for teaching purposes only. **This entry belongs to the round theme of applications that run, and of the several states a Space can be in.** **Note on quotation: the French passages quoted here contain ASCII apostrophes, such as those in the words for employment, annuity, discounting and urgency, and this project follows its existing convention of writing them as a typographic apostrophe; accents and hyphens are preserved as in the source.**

**Verified information, all measured from the platform API, the repository files and one real request**: **first, it cannot run at present, and the platform states this in two contradictory places.** The request to its domain returned a service-unavailable status with a forty-nine byte body stating verbatim that the space is in error and to check its status on the platform, **while the runtime interface returned a body naming a runtime-error stage, a scheduling failure as the error message, a null current hardware value against a requested basic CPU tier, a replica count carrying only a requested value and no current value, and a domain entry whose own stage is marked ready**. **That set of fields is the most valuable record in this entry: within one response the runtime stage is an error while the domain stage is ready, so a reader consulting only the latter would conclude the application is available, while the null hardware value and the absent current replica count together indicate that no compute has been allocated to it at all.** **This entry states plainly that the cause of the scheduling failure could not be determined and does not speculate whether it is a quota, a capacity or a configuration matter.** **Second, the teaching flow is organised in three stages and every stage asks why the learner assumed what they assumed.** The question sets are grouped as data, assumptions and results. The data group asks for necessary demographic data, basic financial data, data broken down by beneficiary type, and **a fourth question about missing data and the limits of the model**. The assumption group asks about employment growth, **the discount rate and the sensitivity of the gap**, **future mortality improvement**, the sensitivity of scheme parameters, and **coverage together with the informal economy**. The results group asks about reading the pay-as-you-go ratio, **the meaning and usefulness of the actuarial gap**, and **nominal against structural deficit**. **That set of headings is itself a transferable syllabus: the data stage devotes one question specifically to missing data and model limits, the assumption stage separates discounting from mortality improvement, and the results stage requires the learner to distinguish a nominal deficit from a structural one.** **Third, four reform levers are drawn as a waterfall** whose labels name an initial gap of four point two two percentage points, the statutory retirement age, the contribution rate, the annuity rate and formal-sector coverage, followed by a residual item. The scheme parameters quoted in the interface give a legal retirement age of sixty, an annuity rate of two and a half percent, a full-service period of thirty-two years and a contribution rate of eighteen and a quarter percent, and learners are asked to rank those four parameters; further cards name an actuarial gap over fifty years at just under twenty-three percent, the contribution rate again, and life expectancy at sixty as a long-term financial commitment; and a coverage scenario asks what happens if coverage rises from fifty-five to seventy percent by 2035. **Together those turn a pension reform recommendation into four levers that can be adjusted and attributed separately, each of which the learner must justify actuarially.** **Fourth, the deliverable is a memorandum with four requirements**: a quantified diagnosis, the urgency of reform, a priority recommendation with actuarial justification, and the main political or social risk to be managed. **The last requirement is the one worth recording, because it asks the learner to state a non-technical risk alongside the technical conclusion.** **Fifth, learner answers are written into a dataset repository that could not be read this round**: the application contains a constant naming a companion responses repository and a function that writes participant answers as a CSV file, using the platform client library and a token environment variable, and **that dataset repository returned an unauthorised response, meaning it is not publicly readable**. **This entry records the structure and states plainly that it does not judge whether the data handling is appropriate.** **Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover pension microsimulation, a pension observatory, a Spanish pension model, a German pension gap calculator and a pension data interface, **while this entry supplies a teaching pension reform simulator published by an international training body that currently cannot be scheduled, and whose runtime and domain stages disagree within a single platform response. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: split a teaching flow into data, assumptions and results, and require the limits to be stated at the data stage; make a reform proposal decomposable into attributable levers and draw it as a waterfall; require one non-technical risk alongside the conclusion; and when reading platform status, read the runtime stage rather than only the domain stage.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the application was not started and no answers were submitted**, so no parameters were entered and no projection was generated, **and no claim is made about any model result or the correctness of any number shown in it**. **Second, only repository files and platform interfaces were read**, structure being recorded from file names, byte sizes and heading strings inside the code, **without reading the two thousand one hundred and eighty line application line by line**. **Third, the source of its data was not verified**, only that the interface describes itself as a simulation for teaching use. **Fourth, the relationship between its scheme parameters and the real scheme was not verified**, only the parameter values appearing verbatim in the interface. **Fifth, the visibility setting of the companion dataset repository was not verified beyond the unauthorised response measured here, nor whether it meets any data protection requirement. Sixth, the authorisation relationship between the Space and the training institution was not verified**, only its account name and self-description being recorded. **Seventh, on the window: the Space was created in early June and last modified the next day, both outside the thaw window**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is a teaching pension reform simulator published by an international training body whose runtime stage and domain stage contradict each other inside one platform response. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the application describes itself as teaching material, that its output is not an actuarial opinion and that it must not be used for real scheme reform decisions.**
